INCIDENT TYPE:
SQL INJECTION

DESCRIPTION:
SQL Injection occurs when attackers manipulate application inputs to execute unauthorized SQL queries against backend databases. Successful exploitation can lead to data theft, authentication bypass, and full database compromise.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1190 | Exploit Public-Facing Application

INDICATORS:
- Database errors
- Unexpected query execution
- Authentication bypass
- Data leakage
- Suspicious SQL patterns

DETECTION RULES:
- SQL keywords in user input
- Unusual database queries
- Authentication bypass attempts

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Web applications
- Databases
- APIs
